about: Hand-written rotation guides for the priest's player pages (guides.py). Rewritten 2026-11-04 on the 2026-11-02 patch data (client 70753): the lists the pages show that day, the full-raid casts and damage shares of the simulator's environments runs (2026-11-03), the healer lab's policy (re-tuned 2026-11-03, unchanged) and the fight lab's 2026-11-04 signature audit (300 fights a level).

raid.plan: Shadow in a raid is **Shadowform** before the pull, **Mind Blast** every time it is ready, **Shadow Word: Pain** kept on the boss, **Devouring Plague** and **Shadow Word: Death** on cooldown, and **Mind Flay** in every gap. The best priest damage page: 788 DPS in a full raid.
why: **Shadowform** is what makes the spec work: 10% more Shadow damage, half the mana cost on every Shadow spell, a doubled critical strike bonus and 15% less physical damage taken. You cannot cast heals in it.

**Mind Blast** comes first (22 casts, 19%): 477-503 damage in a 1.5-second cast every 5.5 seconds with **Improved Mind Blast**. The latest re-tune (2026-11-02) moved it to the top, ahead of **Shadow Word: Death** and the dots, for +0.3%.

**Shadow Word: Pain** (8 casts, 20%): 762 damage over 24 seconds with **Improved Shadow Word: Pain**, for one global cooldown. Recast it when it falls off, not in the last 10 seconds. Every Shadow spell also stacks **Shadow Weaving** on the target (2% more Shadow damage from you per stack, up to 5, for 15 seconds), so steady casting keeps it full.

**Inner Focus** makes your next spell free, and the list spends it on the first **Devouring Plague**: its 985 mana is halved by **Devouring Contagion** but it is still the dearest spell you have; the 25% crit bonus does not apply to a damage-over-time spell, so the pair only saves mana.

**Shadow Word: Death** (9 casts, 9%) and then **Devouring Plague** (7 casts, 11%) each time they are ready: **Shadow Word: Death** is instant on an 18-second cooldown and crits 30% more often below 20% of the boss's health with **Early Demise**; **Devouring Plague** lasts 24 seconds on a 24-second cooldown, so it is up all fight, and heals you for the damage it deals.

**Mind Flay** fills every gap and is 40% of your damage (38 casts): 390 damage over 3 seconds for 205 mana (102 in **Shadowform**), each tick 20% stronger than the last with **Improved Mind Flay**, and **Darkness** adds 10% to everything.
Mana is not your problem in a full raid: the simulator's priest never runs dry with one mana potion and two Demonic Runes a fight. **Spirit Tap** does nothing on a boss: it needs a kill.
caveats: **Shadow Word: Death** hits you for 30% of your maximum health every time the target survives it (the 2026-11-02 patch tripled the backlash), about 9 times in a 3-minute fight: nearly three health bars that your healers pay for. The damage numbers ignore that. **Devouring Plague** heals a little of it back.

**Mind Blast** causes a lot of threat (its tooltip says so) and leads the list. In the first seconds of a fight or after a tank swap, hold it until the tank is ahead; **Silent Resolve** cuts the threat of your spells by 30%.

When you must move, **Mind Flay** and **Mind Blast** stop: use the instants, **Shadow Word: Death**, **Devouring Plague** and **Shadow Word: Pain** if it fell off. **Shadow Weaving** drops after 15 seconds without a Shadow spell.
A 6-minute fight: the simulator's DPS falls from 788 at 3 minutes to 483 at 6 as the mana runs out.
diverge: If your healers struggle, cast **Shadow Word: Death** only in the last 20% of the boss's health, where **Early Demise** makes it crit: fewer casts, each more likely to kill (no backlash on a kill). You give up a few percent of damage.

With adds up, keep **Shadow Word: Pain** on the ones that live longest and **Devouring Plague** on one that dies first: **Devouring Contagion** makes the plague jump to two nearby enemies when its target dies. The simulator fights one target.

**Vampiric Embrace** has no line because the simulator counts only damage: on the boss, for 30 seconds your party heals for 20% of your Shadow damage, for 40 mana and one global cooldown. **Silence** stops a casting add.

Out of mana in a long fight: **Dark Sacrifice** (an Undead racial spell, so only Undead priests have it) turns 1,600 of your health over 15 seconds into 1,600 mana plus your Spirit, once every 10 minutes; the full list holds it below **Mind Flay**, so it only fires when you cannot afford a **Mind Flay**.

leveling.plan: Shadow levels on a short loop: **Shadow Word: Pain** and **Mind Blast** land while the mob runs in, **Mind Flay** slows and kills it, and **Shadow Word: Death** or your wand finishes it. **Shadowform** at 40 is the big step. In the fight lab a kill takes about 24 seconds level-weighted (20 at level 60), the fastest priest leveling page by far.
why: Open from as far away as you can: the fight lab casts the instants first (**Vampiric Embrace** from 39 when it is ready, then **Shadow Word: Pain**) and **Mind Blast**, your biggest hit, right after, so they land while the mob walks in. **Shadow Reach** (19 and 23) adds 20% range to your Shadow spells.

**Mind Flay** (level 20) is your filler: it slows the mob by 50% while you channel, so a mob walking in reaches you later, and **Improved Mind Flay** (21-22) makes each tick 20% stronger than the last. **Mind Blast** goes out whenever it is ready; **Improved Mind Blast** (24, 31-34) takes 2.5 seconds off its 8-second cooldown.

**Shadow Word: Death** (32) finishes: the fight lab casts it when one cast will kill the mob, so its backlash (30% of your maximum health when the target survives) never lands. **Early Demise** (35) adds 15% crit chance to it on a mob at or below 20% of its health, and the lab casts it there too. The tooltip gives no other bonus, so that cast can leave the mob alive and cost you the backlash.
Before 20 your wand fills the gaps between **Mind Blast** casts and finishes: when a mob has a hit or two of wand damage left, a new spell is wasted mana.

**Vampiric Embrace** (39) is your heal once **Shadowform** stops real heals: for 30 seconds your party heals for 20% of the Shadow damage you deal to that mob, and the fight lab casts it whenever it is ready. **Shadowform** (40) adds 10% Shadow damage, halves your Shadow costs and takes 15% off physical damage: time per kill drops from 37 seconds at level 39 to 22 at level 40.

Mana: **Spirit Tap** (10-14) gives a chance after a kill to double your Spirit for 15 seconds and keeps half your regeneration going meanwhile, and **Shadowform** halves your Shadow costs, so the tuned rules drink only below 15% mana. They also skip the pre-pull **Power Word: Shield** unless you start a pull below half your health: the shield is not a Shadow spell and costs full mana.
caveats: The tuned rules never cast **Devouring Plague** (it costs a lot of mana and most mobs die before its 24 seconds end) nor **Smite**.

**Shadowform** blocks your heals but cuts the physical damage you take by 15%: from 40 your only healing in a fight is **Vampiric Embrace**, and between fights you eat (below 40% of your health, the tuned rule) instead of casting **Renew**.

Most points go into Shadow damage and hit: **Shadow Focus** (15-18), **Darkness** (36-38, 41-42, up to 10% Shadow damage), **Shadow Weaving** (28-30), **Dark Inspiration** (25-27, 43-44). The last 16 points (45-60) go to mana and filler: **Twin Disciplines** (45-49), **Twilight Focus** (50-52), **Mental Strength** (53-55), **Power in Light** (56-57, a **Smite** and **Penance** talent this rotation never uses) and **Meditation** (58-60).
Two or three mobs at once: put **Shadow Word: Pain** on each and use **Psychic Scream** (below 40% of your health with a mob on you) to buy time. The rules were tuned on single pulls.
diverge: When a pull goes wrong (an add, a caster pack), shield yourself: **Power Word: Shield** absorbs damage and stops pushback on your casts while it holds.
Below 40% health with the mob on you: **Psychic Scream**, then **Flash Heal** if you are not in **Shadowform** yet.
In **Shadowform** a real heal means leaving the form (the macros page has a macro for it) and clicking it back on afterwards, so eat between fights instead and keep **Vampiric Embrace** up.

raid.plan: Smite in a raid keeps **Shadow Word: Pain** on the boss, fires **Mind Blast** every time it is ready, keeps **Holy Fire** burning while your mana holds, casts **Shadow Word: Death** on cooldown and **Smite** in every gap. **Power in Light** is the tree's reason: your **Smite** deals 10% more while your **Holy Fire** or **Shadow Word: Pain** is on the target. 602 DPS in a full raid against the Shadow page's 788.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** (8 casts, 19%) comes first: instant, 762 damage over 24 seconds with **Improved Shadow Word: Pain**, and the cheapest way to keep **Power in Light** on. Recast it when it falls off, not in the last 10 seconds.

**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready (22 casts, 19%): 477-503 damage in a 1.5-second cast every 5.5 seconds with **Improved Mind Blast**. It costs more than a **Smite** but lands far more per cast; **Shadow Focus** gives it hit.

**Inner Focus** goes into **Devouring Plague** at the pull: the plague is free that once (985 mana otherwise, which this build cannot halve) and runs 24 seconds. In a longer fight the second **Inner Focus** goes into a **Smite** for its 25% crit bonus.

**Holy Fire** (6 casts, 8%): 184-232 damage plus 75 over 10 seconds in a 3-second cast with **Divine Fury**; one goes out 3 seconds before the pull, and the list recasts it as its burn ends while you have at least 40% mana. **Searing Light** adds 5% Holy damage, **Holy Specialization** 5% crit, **Holy Precision** 18% hit.
**Shadow Word: Death** (10 casts, 8%) on its 18-second cooldown: the list casts rank 3 (the search measured it 0.5% ahead of rank 4: less mana for nearly the same hit).

**Smite** is the filler (60 casts, 45%): 2 seconds with **Divine Fury**, 280 mana less **Mental Agility**'s 10%, 10% more under your **Shadow Word: Pain** or **Holy Fire**. The page's two **Smite** lines are mana gates: top rank above 25% mana; between 20 and 25% the full list drops to rank 2, under 20% to rank 7, and only when you cannot afford even that does it channel **Mind Flay** (no casts in the simulator's raid fights).

Mana: **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast; the simulator's priest also uses two mana potions and two Demonic Runes a fight and still runs dry late. In a 6-minute fight its DPS falls from 602 to 280.
caveats: This build has no **Penance** (it needs 20 Discipline points) and no **Power Infusion** or **Shadowform**: the full list's lines for them never fire. The Smite page is a showcase for the tree, 24% behind Shadow.
**Shadow Word: Death** hits you for 30% of your maximum health each time the boss survives it, about 10 times a fight: your healers pay for that.
When you must move, use the instants: **Shadow Word: Death**, and **Shadow Word: Pain** if it fell off. **Holy Fire**, **Smite** and **Mind Blast** all need you to stand still.

Ranks far below your level get much less from your spell power (a Forever change; our model gives rank 2 a small share of it), so the rank-2 **Smite** line is a stopgap, not a mana trick to use early.
diverge: When the boss has under 3 seconds to live, cast **Smite** rather than a new **Holy Fire**: only a spell that finishes casting does damage.
If healing is tight, cast **Shadow Word: Death** only in the last 20% of the boss's health, as the simulator's rotation for fighting alone does.
Packs: **Holy Nova** hits everything within 10 yards and heals your party, and **Searing Light** gives each **Holy Fire** tick a 10% chance to make your next **Holy Nova** cost no mana.

leveling.plan: Leveling as Smite: open with **Holy Fire**, keep **Shadow Word: Pain** on the mob, cast **Mind Blast** whenever it is ready and **Smite** in every gap, and let your wand take the last hit. A **Power Word: Shield** before every pull lets you keep casting in melee. In the fight lab a kill takes about 51 seconds level-weighted (49 at level 60), twice the Shadow page's 24.
why: **Holy Fire** (level 20) opens from range: a hard hit and a 10-second burn. The fight lab casts it again once the burn has ended while the mob has more than 40% of its health, in melee only while your shield holds. **Inner Focus** (26) goes up as the pull starts, so the opening **Holy Fire** is free and its hit 25% more likely to crit.

**Shadow Word: Pain** is instant and ticks for the whole fight; **Improved Shadow Word: Pain** (59-60) makes it last longer. While it or **Holy Fire** burns on the mob, **Power in Light** (14-18) makes **Smite** 10% stronger.
**Smite** is your main spell. **Divine Fury** (47-51) takes half a second off its cast and **Holy Fire**'s, **Holy Specialization** (42-46) adds 5% crit and **Searing Light** (56-57) 5% Holy damage.

**Mind Blast** goes out whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana (a tuned rule); **Smite** at any mana until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit, then your wand finishes, 25% stronger with **Wand Specialization** (10-11).

Mana: drink only below 15%. **Meditation** (22-24) keeps half your regeneration going while you cast, **Mental Agility** (20-21 and 25) cuts **Smite** and **Holy Fire**'s cost by 10%, **Spirit Tap** (32-36) doubles your Spirit after a kill.
caveats: The pre-pull shield is part of this rotation: **Smite** and **Holy Fire** take 2 seconds or more to cast, and while **Power Word: Shield** holds, damage does not push your casts back. In melee, shield again once Weakened Soul is gone and you are below 80% health; **Soul Warding** (31) cuts the shield's cooldown by 4 seconds and its cost by 15%, **Twilight Focus** (37-39) avoids most pushback in between.
This build has no **Penance**: skip that line. The tuned rules never cast **Devouring Plague**.
**Holy Nova** (52) is for pulls of several mobs: the fight lab casts it only when two or more are in reach. Otherwise pull one mob at a time; with two on you, **Psychic Scream** sends them running.
After a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk on (below 85% health); you eat below 80% health (a tuned rule).
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you.
For pure speed, level as Shadow: 24 seconds per kill in the fight lab against this build's 51.

raid.plan: The healer lab's Holy priest heals the tank with **Penance** every time it is ready and with **Greater Heal** downranked to the damage he has taken, heals the rest of the group only once they drop below 60% health (**Prayer of Healing** when two or more are that low), and keeps **Power Word: Shield** and **Flash Heal** for emergencies. Mana is the limit: even so, the lab's Holy priest spends part of its five-minute fight out of mana. The heal-choice policy was re-tuned on 2026-11-03 and did not move.
why: **Penance** goes on the tank whenever it comes off cooldown and he is missing most of what it heals: 425 healing at once and every second for 2 seconds, 385 mana less **Improved Healing**'s 15%, on a 12-second cooldown. It heals more per mana than **Heal** and **Greater Heal**, and the healer lab measured about 6% more capacity than keeping it for emergencies.

**Greater Heal** is still your biggest heal. Start it on the tank when he is missing about half of what it heals and a boss swing is coming, at the lowest rank that covers what he is missing: the rest of a bigger rank would be overheal.

**Prayer of Healing** when two or more of your group are below 60% health (the class's tuned heal policy: two, not three, and 60%, not 70%); one hurt member below 60% gets **Renew** or a **Flash Heal**. In Forever **Prayer of Healing** heals the target and the target's party, so aim it at the group that is hurt.
**Renew** goes on the tank once he is missing a fifth of his health (the tuned policy, rather than a tenth), and on a raid member below 60% before a direct heal; **Improved Renew** adds 15% to it.

**Inner Focus** goes on a full-rank **Greater Heal** when the tank is missing more than half of one: the heal is free and 25% more likely to crit, and a critical heal gives the tank 25% more armor for 15 seconds through **Inspiration**.

In an emergency (anyone below 20% health): **Power Word: Shield** on the tank if Weakened Soul is gone, then **Penance** if it is ready, then a full-rank **Flash Heal**. That threshold is the class's tuned heal policy (the default was 35%); **Soul Warding** takes the shield's 4-second cooldown away and cuts its cost by 15%.
caveats: Mana runs out before healing power does: **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast, **Improved Healing** makes **Greater Heal** and **Penance** 15% cheaper, and **Spiritual Guidance** at 4 points turns a fifth of your Spirit into healing. The tuned policy takes a mana potion below 40% of your mana.
This build has no **Prayer of Mending** (it needs 31 points in Holy).

Ranks far below your level get less from your healing power (a Forever change; the formula is our assumption). In our model **Greater Heal** ranks 3 to 5 lose nothing and rank 1 about 15%, so downranking within **Greater Heal** still pays.
The lab is one healer keeping a tank and four players alive for five minutes. It does not model movement, dispels or other healers.
**Silent Resolve** (3 points) cuts the threat your spells cause by 30%: the healer lab models no threat, so it measures nothing there.
diverge: **Litany of Light** gives back 10% of a heal's base cost when it differs from your previous heal, so when two heals fit equally well, alternate them.
**Holy Nova** heals everyone around you; the lab never casts it, so use it only when your group stands together and is hurt.

leveling.plan: You level with your raid talents, Discipline first: the first Holy point comes at level 32. The fight is a Smite priest's: **Holy Fire** to open, **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Penance** and **Mind Blast** whenever they are ready, **Smite** in every gap and your wand for the last hit. In the fight lab a kill takes about 57 seconds level-weighted, 2.4 times the Shadow page's 24.
why: **Holy Fire** (level 20) opens from range: a 3.4-second cast (this build takes one point of **Divine Fury**, 0.1 seconds off) that hits hard and burns for 10 seconds more. The fight lab casts it again once the burn has ended while the mob has more than 40% of its health, in melee only while your **Power Word: Shield** holds (damage would push the long cast back). **Inner Focus** (23) goes up as the pull starts, so the opening **Holy Fire** is free and its hit 25% more likely to crit.
**Shadow Word: Pain** is instant and ticks for the whole fight; **Twin Disciplines** (10-14) adds 5% to it and your other instant spells.
**Penance** (30) goes out whenever it is ready: three Holy hits in 2 seconds on a 12-second cooldown, 15% cheaper with **Improved Healing** (49-51).

**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana; **Smite** fills every gap at any mana until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit, then your wand finishes.
Mana: you drink only below 15%. **Meditation** (20-22) keeps half your regeneration going while you cast and **Mental Strength** (15-19) adds 10% Intellect.

The pre-pull **Power Word: Shield** is part of this rotation: while it holds, damage does not push your casts back; **Soul Warding** (31) takes its 4-second cooldown away and **Twilight Focus** (32-34) avoids most pushback after it breaks.
caveats: Most of your Holy points are for healing (**Improved Renew**, **Inspiration**, **Holy Binding**, **Litany of Light**, **Spiritual Guidance**, **Spiritual Healing**), so this is a slow way to level: 57 seconds per kill level-weighted in the fight lab against 24 for Shadow.
The tuned rules never cast **Devouring Plague** and hold **Mind Blast** below 30% mana: the gate keeps **Smite** and **Holy Fire** your main damage (the spec's rule).
**Holy Nova** (42) is for pulls of several mobs: the fight lab casts it only when two or more are in reach.
After a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk on (below 85% health); you eat below 80% health (a tuned rule).
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
If you only want to reach 60, level as Shadow and respec: about 2.4 times as fast per kill in the fight lab.

raid.plan: The healer lab plays Discipline with the class's heal choices: **Penance** on the tank whenever it is ready, downranked **Greater Heal** on the tank, **Prayer of Healing** when the group drops below 60%, and **Power Word: Shield** and **Flash Heal** for emergencies. **Divine Aegis** and **Soul Warding** are what the deep Discipline points buy here; this build, the deep search's winner, takes neither **Power Infusion** nor **Renewed Hope**.
why: **Penance** goes on the tank whenever it comes off cooldown and he is missing most of what it heals: 425 healing at once and every second for 2 seconds, 385 mana less **Improved Healing**'s 15%. It heals more per mana than **Heal** and **Greater Heal**, and the healer lab measured about 4% more capacity than keeping it for emergencies.
**Greater Heal** on the tank is your biggest heal. Start it when he is missing about half of what it heals and a boss swing is coming, at the lowest rank that covers the damage.

In an emergency (anyone below 20% health): **Power Word: Shield** on the tank if Weakened Soul is gone, then **Penance** if it is ready, then a full-rank **Flash Heal**. **Soul Warding** removes the shield's 4-second cooldown and cuts its cost by 15%; **Improved Power Word: Shield** makes it absorb 20% more.

Each critical direct heal leaves an absorb of 15% of the heal on the target (**Divine Aegis**, at most 1,200) and gives him 25% more armor for 15 seconds (**Inspiration**); **Holy Specialization** makes the crits more common.

**Inner Focus** on a full-rank **Greater Heal** when the tank is missing more than half of one; **Prayer of Healing** when two or more of the group drop below 60% (the tuned policy; the default was 70%); **Renew** on the tank once he is missing a fifth of his health.
caveats: Mana runs out first. **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast; the tuned policy takes a mana potion below 40% of your mana.
The lab shields only in emergencies: shielding the tank every time Weakened Soul ends measured slightly worse there, because the shields cost mana the fight runs short of.

Ranks far below your level get less from your healing power (a Forever change; the formula is our assumption). In our model **Greater Heal** ranks 3 to 5 lose nothing, so downranking within **Greater Heal** still pays.

This build gives up **Power Infusion**, **Renewed Hope**, **Spiritual Guidance**, **Spiritual Healing** and **Prayer of Mending**; in the healer lab it holds about 6% less than the Holy page's build (0.65 against 0.69).
**Silent Resolve** (3 points) cuts the threat your spells cause by 30%: the healer lab models no threat, so it measures nothing there.
diverge: **Litany of Light** (2 points) gives back 10% of a heal's base cost when it differs from your previous heal: alternate heals when two fit equally well. The second point measured +3.6% capacity in the healer lab (2026-11-09).
With mana to spare, shield the tank more often: the lab's shields only went out in emergencies because mana ran out first.

leveling.plan: Leveling as Discipline in your raid talents: **Shadow Word: Pain** and **Devouring Plague** on the mob, **Penance** and **Mind Blast** whenever they are ready, **Smite** in the gaps while you have more than 30% of your mana, and your wand for the rest. The build is the Discipline raid healer's (29/22/0): Discipline's damage and mana talents first, **Penance** at 30, then the Holy healing talents. In the fight lab a kill takes about 46 seconds level-weighted (46 at level 60), 1.9 times the Shadow page's 24.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** pulls: it is instant and ticks for the whole fight. **Devouring Plague** (level 20) follows while the mob has more than 30% of its health: the Discipline list keeps it (the Shadow and Holy lists do not), and it heals you for its damage. **Twin Disciplines** (10-13) adds 4% to both, and to the shield and **Renew**.

**Penance** (30) whenever it is ready while the mob has more than 35% of its health: three Holy hits in 2 seconds. **Power in Light** (14, one point) makes it and **Smite** 2% stronger while your **Shadow Word: Pain** burns, **Holy Specialization** (35-39) adds crit to both, and **Improved Healing** (48-50) makes **Penance** 15% cheaper.
**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready, at any mana, while the mob has more than 10% of its health; it also finishes a mob one cast will kill.
**Smite** only while the mob has more than 35% of its health and you have more than 30% of your mana: otherwise your wand fills the gaps and finishes. **Divine Fury** (40) shortens its cast.

Mana sets the pace: you drink only below 15%. **Mental Strength** (15-19) gives 10% more Intellect, **Meditation** (22-24) keeps half your regeneration going while you cast, and **Mental Agility** (20-21, 25) cuts the cost of **Smite** and your instants by 10%.
**Inner Focus** (26) goes up as the pull starts: your first spell is free.
caveats: The tuned rules shield before a pull only when you start it below 80% health. In melee, shield again below 80% once Weakened Soul is gone, so damage does not push your **Smite** back; **Twilight Focus** (31-33) stops most of that pushback too.
The tuned rules never cast **Holy Fire**. This build takes no **Power Infusion** or **Renewed Hope**.
From 51 the points are the raid healer's: **Litany of Light**, **Silent Resolve**, **Soul Warding** and **Divine Aegis** do little solo.
These are your raid healing talents: healers level in their raid build, so there is no respec at 60. The search's Discipline build for leveling alone (under Other builds) kills about 15% faster.
After a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk on (below 85% health); eat only if you are still below two thirds of your health.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
If you only want to reach 60, level as Shadow and respec: about 1.9 times as fast per kill in the fight lab.

leveling.plan: A Discipline-Shadow build levels with the Shadow leveling list, the rotation that plays its signature spells (**Shadow Word: Pain** and **Mind Flay**): instants while the mob runs in, **Mind Blast** whenever it is ready, **Mind Flay** in between, and **Shadow Word: Death** or your wand to finish.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** (and **Vampiric Embrace** when the build has it) go out first, then **Mind Blast**, so they land while the mob walks in.
**Mind Flay** is the filler: it slows the mob by 50% while you channel. The build needs the **Mind Flay** talent: without it the list has no filler and your wand does the work.

**Shadow Word: Death** (level 32) when one cast will kill the mob, so its backlash (30% of your maximum health when the target survives) never lands; **Early Demise** adds crit chance to it at or below 20% health, and the lab casts it there too.

Mana: the tuned Shadow rules drink only below 15% and shield before a pull only below half your health. **Spirit Tap** doubles your Spirit after a kill, **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast and **Twin Disciplines** makes your instants and **Mind Flay** stronger.
caveats: The tuned rules never cast **Devouring Plague** or **Smite**, and the Shadow list has no **Penance** line: Discipline's **Smite** and **Penance** talents do nothing on it.
With fewer than 31 Shadow points there is no **Shadowform**: your Shadow spells cost full mana, but you can still heal (**Flash Heal** below a third of your health, **Renew** after a fight).
diverge: When a pull goes wrong, shield yourself: **Power Word: Shield** absorbs damage and stops pushback while it holds; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
For speed, the Shadow page is the fastest priest leveling build in the fight lab.

leveling.plan: A Holy-Shadow build levels with the Holy leveling list, the rotation that plays its signature spells (**Shadow Word: Pain** and **Holy Fire**): **Holy Fire** to open, **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Mind Blast** above 30% mana, **Smite** in every gap and your wand for the last hit, with a **Power Word: Shield** before every pull.
why: **Holy Fire** opens from range and is cast again once its burn has ended while the mob has more than 40% of its health, in melee only while your shield holds. **Inner Focus**, when the build has it, goes up as the pull starts and makes that opening **Holy Fire** free.

The Shadow points make **Shadow Word: Pain** and **Mind Blast** better and your mana last: **Spirit Tap**, **Improved Shadow Word: Pain**, **Improved Mind Blast** and **Shadow Weaving**, whichever the build takes.

**Mind Blast** whenever it is ready while you have more than 30% of your mana; **Smite** at any mana until the mob has less health left than about half a **Smite** hit, then your wand finishes. **Penance**, when the build has it, goes out whenever it is ready.
caveats: The Holy list never casts **Mind Flay** or **Vampiric Embrace**: Shadow points in them only open tiers. The tuned rules never cast **Devouring Plague**.
Drink below 15% of your mana; after a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk on (below 85% health), and you eat below 80%.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
For speed, level as Shadow.
